minutes.headline: Planning Board approved all of Monday's hearings, including a Table Rock parking lot on Northfield Road over neighbor objections.
minutes.summary: The board opened early for an executive session, then held a run of public hearings and approvals. The longest was the Conservation Commission's Table Rock parking lot at 994 Northfield Road (rear), where neighbors and the neighboring golf course objected. It was approved with special conditions. The board also signed earlier decisions and heard updates on the ADU and flood plain bylaws.

budget_items.what_was_said: The Conservation Commission received grant money to build the parking lot. A resident asked whether the grant could instead improve the existing lot, and the commission chair said the grant is restricted to the Table Rock parcel.
The Conservation Commission chair said the town bought the parcel with a grant that covered only part of its value.
A commission member said the commission has no tax dollars for maintaining conservation land. Work is grant-funded or done by volunteers.

budget_items.topic: Security cameras at the parking lot
budget_items.what_was_said: A board member cited solar cellular cameras available online. A commission member said there is no budget for cameras, and the commission chair said it would consider cameras if the town budgeted them.
The stormwater task force is working on fee structures and how fees will be assessed and communicated, with a brief town meeting introduction planned.

decisions.decision: Board agreed to include a park-at-own-risk signage special condition at 994 Northfield Road, since the applicant agreed.
Board agreed to condition that the applicant petition for an address change, rather than require the outcome, after a member's point of order.
The ADU and flood plain bylaw public hearings are to be advertised for the second April meeting.
The board deferred the standard operating procedures review to a later meeting.
The board will sign the 558/560 Goodrich and 255 Sunny Hill decisions without a new vote; the land use director will scan and file them.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board approved the site plan for the Table Rock parking lot at 994 Northfield Road (rear) with special conditions, after neighbors objected.
The special conditions are park-at-own-risk signage and a condition that the applicant petition for an address change.
The board also approved the 494 Electric Avenue site plan and stormwater permit, the 213 Electric Avenue stormwater permit, and a de minimis change at the 7-Eleven on Mass Ave.
The board approved site plan review for battery storage at 485 Lemoner Shirley Road and a common driveway special permit at 1523 Mass Ave with three waivers.
The ADU and flood plain bylaw hearings are to be advertised for the second April meeting, and a review of the board's standard operating procedures was deferred.

why_it_matters: The Table Rock lot was funded by a grant restricted to that parcel, and the Conservation Commission said it has no tax money for maintenance or cameras, so upkeep and security there depend on grants and volunteers unless a town budget line is added.
The ADU and flood plain bylaw changes are headed to town meeting, so residents will be asked to vote on them after the April hearings.
